title: Math Core graphing
subtitle: Type an expression. Undefined letters become sliders.
engineRestarted: The calculation took longer than 5 seconds and was stopped.
linkTooLarge: Too large to share as a link. Use JSON export instead.
importFailed: That file is not a valid graph.
precision: Values beyond 10⁸ lose precision in double arithmetic.
notYet: {{kind}} items are drawn from Phase {{phase}} on.
graphLabel: Graph. Use the arrow keys to pan and plus or minus to zoom.

describe.extent_one: {{label}}: one piece spanning x from {{xmin}} to {{xmax}} and y from {{ymin}} to {{ymax}}
describe.extent_other: {{label}}: {{count}} pieces spanning x from {{xmin}} to {{xmax}} and y from {{ymin}} to {{ymax}}
describe.region: {{label}}: the shaded region covers about {{percent}}% of the view
describe.regionAll: {{label}}: the shaded region fills the whole view
describe.regionNone: {{label}}: no shaded region in this view
describe.boundary: its boundary spans x from {{xmin}} to {{xmax}} and y from {{ymin}} to {{ymax}}
describe.systemUnique: {{label}}: linear system with the unique solution {{solution}}.
describe.systemInfinite: {{label}}: linear system with infinitely many solutions.

linkInvalid: This link is not a valid graph, so a new graph is shown. The address stays until you edit.

linalg.rotation: Complex eigenvalues α ± iβ: there is no real eigen-direction. In the basis of the real and imaginary parts of an eigenvector, the matrix rotates by θ = {{angle}}° and scales by r = {{scale}}.
linalg.noInverse: No inverse: the matrix is singular (rank {{rank}}).
linalg.planes3d: Turn on the 3D view to see the three planes and where they meet.
linalg.matrix3d: Turn on the 3D view to see the image of the unit cube.
linalg.panelFailed: The matrix report could not load. Check the connection and reload the page.

view3dNote: 3D view: 3×3 matrices and systems. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Curves and regions are drawn in the 2D view.
graphLabel3d: 3D graph. Use the arrow keys to orbit and plus or minus to zoom.

errors.nodeLimit: Expression has {{nodes}} nodes; the limit is {{max}}
errors.complexNumbers: Complex numbers are not available yet (decision D2)
errors.wrongArgCount: {{fn}} has the wrong number of arguments
errors.primeNeedsName: Prime notation needs a variable name
errors.derivativeVariableName: Derivative variable must be a name
errors.matrixRowNotList: Matrix row is not a list
errors.integralLimits: Only definite integrals with both limits are supported
errors.needsIndexLimits: {{name}} needs an index and both limits
errors.derivativeVariableUndefined: Derivative variable {{name}} is not defined here
errors.integrationVariableName: Integration variable must be a name
errors.functionName: Function name must be a symbol
errors.recursionDepth: Function calls nest deeper than {{max}} (recursive definition?)
errors.entryNotFinite: A matrix or right-side entry is not a finite number
errors.notMatrix: "{{name}}" is not a matrix defined in this graph
errors.selfDerivative: a variable cannot be differentiated with respect to itself
errors.firstOrderOnly: only first-order ODEs dy/dx = F(x, y) are supported
errors.derivativeOnLeft: write the derivative on the left: dy/dx = F(x, y)
errors.surfaceNeeds3D: z = f(x, y) surfaces need 3D (deferred by decision D3)
errors.chainedComparison: chained comparisons are only supported as restrictions {a < x < b}
errors.pairVariables: a pair cannot use x or y; use t for parametric curves
errors.complexMapDeferred: w = f(z) complex maps are deferred by decision D2
errors.yNeedsEquation: an expression in y needs an equation, for example x = g(y) or F(x, y) = 0
errors.zEquation: equations in z need 3D or complex mode (decisions D2, D3)
errors.equationNeedsXY: an equation needs x or y to plot
errors.matrixSizeV1: only 2×2 and 3×3 matrices are supported in v1
errors.unknownsColumn: write the unknowns as a column, for example [x; y]
errors.rightSideColumn: the right side of A x = b must be a column
errors.systemSizeV1: only 2×2 and 3×3 systems are supported in v1
errors.rightSideEntries: the right side needs {{n}} entries, one per unknown
errors.unknownNames: the unknowns must be names, for example x, y
errors.unknownOnce: each unknown may appear only once
errors.rightSideUnknowns: the right side cannot contain the unknowns
errors.needsMatrixA: A x = b needs a matrix A
errors.matrixUnknowns: the matrix cannot contain the unknowns
errors.systemShape: a system needs 2 equations in x, y or 3 equations in x, y, z
errors.strayUnknown: a system of {{count}} equations uses only {{unknowns}}; {{stray}} is not allowed

graphing.title: Graphing
graphing.blurb: Explicit, implicit, inequalities, parametric and polar curves.

calculus.title: Calculus
calculus.blurb: Derivative with its tangent, definite integral with its area.

algebra.title: Algebra
algebra.blurb: Only what exists: the zeros of a curve.

unsupported.indefiniteIntegral: Indefinite integrals $\int f(x)\,dx$ as a formula: not yet supported (without bounds, $a$ and $b$ become sliders).
unsupported.symbolicDerivative: Symbolic derivatives (the formula of $f'$): not yet supported; $f'$ is computed numerically.
unsupported.systemBeyond3: Systems with more than 3 unknowns: not yet supported.
unsupported.matrixBeyond3: General $n\times n$ matrices ($n>3$): not yet supported.

explicit.title: Explicit curve
explicit.explain: $y=f(x)$. A letter that is not defined, like $a$, becomes a slider: drag it to change the curve.

implicit.title: Implicit curve
implicit.explain: $F(x,y)=0$: the circle of radius 2, drawn by marching squares.

inequality.title: Inequality
inequality.explain: The region $y>x^2-2$ is shaded; the boundary is dashed because the inequality is strict.

parametric.title: Parametric curve
parametric.explain: $(x(t),y(t))$. Only $t$ is the parameter; it runs over a range chosen from the view.

derivative.title: Derivative and tangent
derivative.explain: Draws $f'$ and the tangent of $f$ at $x_0$. Without a defined $x_0$, one slider $x_0$ is created. Drag the point or the slider.

integral.title: Definite integral
integral.explain: Shades the area between $f$ and the $x$-axis from $a$ to $b$ and shows the value: $\int_0^1 x^2\,dx=\tfrac13$. A missing bound becomes a slider $a$ or $b$.

zeros.title: Zeros of a curve
zeros.explain: The text description of the graph lists where the curve crosses zero: here $x=-2$ and $x=2$.

system2.title: Two equations
system2.explain: Two lines; the solution is where they meet, with the Gauss-Jordan steps.

systemMatrix.title: A x = b
systemMatrix.explain: A named matrix times the unknowns $[x;y]$ equals a column of constants.

matrix2.title: 2×2 matrix
matrix2.explain: $\det A$, orientation, eigenvalues, inverse with steps, and the transformed grid. The second line reads $\det(A)$ from the report.

matrix3.title: 3×3 matrix
matrix3.explain: A diagonal matrix: $\det=24$, eigenvalues $2,3,4$. Turn on the 3D view to see the image of the unit cube.

why.slider: A name equal to a number is a slider.
why.capitalScalar: A capital letter equal to a number can be a slider or a constant.
why.xAssigned: $x$ is an input variable. The engine reads $x=3$ as the vertical line; choose input to hide it.
why.tAssigned: $t$ is the input variable of parametric curves and cannot be assigned. Use another name for a slider.
why.function: A later use of the name calls this function.
why.matrix: A named matrix is a constant. Edit its entries below.
why.definedValue: A value computed from other names.

calc.tangentAt: Tangent at the point $x_0$. Drag the point or the slider $x_0$.
calc.integralBounds: A missing bound is a slider: $a$ and $b$.

matrixOps.singular: No inverse: the matrix is singular.
matrixOps.notMatrix: "{{name}}" is not a matrix defined in this graph.

matrixEditor.label: Entries of {{name}}
matrixEditor.symbolic: Entries with letters can be edited in the expression above.

rows.arrows: Up / Down in an expression: go to the previous / next expression
rows.escape: Leave the input (focus returns to the row); close this panel
rows.help: Open this panel (when no input has focus)
rows.canvasPan: On the graph: pan (2D) or orbit (3D)
rows.canvasZoom: On the graph: zoom in / out
rows.slider: On a slider: change the value; Home / End: ends of the range
